title: Shulker local settings
description: A project's settings for this machine alone, kept in shulker.local.json and out of version control. Shulker writes this file; losing it resets features to the manifest's defaults.

$schema.description: The version of this file, as a published schema URL.

features.description: This machine's feature decisions, by feature name, overriding the manifest's defaults.

syncDirs.description: The directories each side was synced into from this project, so unlink and sync can find them.

detectedOs.description: The operating system shulker detected when it last set this machine's features.
